insight: Began as a meeting-agenda and management tool on fellow.app, then repositioned around AI notetaking and moved to the fellow.ai domain.
name: Fellow
tagline: AI meeting assistant that records, transcribes, and summarizes.
description: Fellow is an AI meeting assistant and notetaker that transcribes, summarizes, and extracts action items from calls with human-level accuracy. It offers both bot-based and botless recording, works across Zoom, Google Meet, and Teams, and its Ask Fellow agent answers questions across past meetings.
edge: Pairs botless and bot-based recording with cross-meeting Ask Fellow search and a security posture aimed at regulated teams.
pros: Works across Zoom, Meet, and Teams
Free plan with 10 AI notes and recordings
Security posture suited to regulated teams
cons: AI features capped on the free plan
Best value needs a paid Team/Business plan

references.title: Fellow AI Review: All the Key Pros and Cons
